# StreamVista Cloud X

> Secure creator-studio cloud platform for media professionals to onboard, store, share, and monetise content. White-labeled for StreamVista with Oracle Cloud–backed storage and Razorpay payments.

StreamVista Cloud X is a SaaS for creators, studios, and executive producers. Each workspace gets its own Oracle Cloud child account for isolated storage. Plans include a free tier and paid creator tiers with bandwidth and storage allowances.
